描述_EN: vase, porcelain with decoration incised, washed and painted in overglaze enamels. round the neck peony scrolls. pear-shaped with contracted neck and spreading mouth. round the body a band of chrysanthemum scrolls washed over in red above a band of ruyi sceptre beads in colours.
